title: Wikidata Statements
contribution: Statement = property/value plus optional qualifiers, references, ranks; supports conflicting sourced values
boundary: ActaKit claims should not collapse into atomic property/value statements

title: Wikidata Qualifiers / Data Model
contribution: Temporal/jurisdiction/method qualifiers contextualize assertions; restrictive qualifiers change meaning
boundary: Universal qualifier graph would make ActaKit harder to explain

title: Wikidata merge guidance
contribution: Requires certainty before merge, redirects obsolete IDs and forbids reuse of merged identifiers
boundary: Do not copy community consensus/rank machinery wholesale

title: Wikidata redirect guidance
contribution: Redirects preserve references and allow merge reversibility; merged IDs are not repurposed
boundary: ActaKit can use smaller lineage semantics without wiki redirects as a UI construct

title: Wikidata qualifiers guidance
contribution: Qualifiers encode time, method, scope and other context when a simple property/value is insufficient
boundary: Do not atomize every claim into property/value/qualifier triples

title: Wikidata ranking guidance
contribution: Separates reference/source from preferred/current consensus rank and permits multiple sourced values
boundary: ActaKit should not implement consensus ranking as truth state
